name: Radar
author: Mar
description: A radar of the Bluetooth devices and Wi-Fi networks around you: device icons, find a lost device hot/cold, tracker and camera-glasses alerts, proximity lock. Listens only, keeps nothing.

barWidget.description: Nearby Bluetooth devices and Wi-Fi networks. Click to open, right-click to start or stop scanning.

schema.label: Stop scanning after (minutes)
schema.description: Scanning stops on its own after this long, to spare battery and Bluetooth audio. 0 keeps scanning until you switch it off.

schema.label: Radar range (metres)
schema.description: Distance at the radar's outer ring. Anything farther sits on the rim.

schema.label: Classic Bluetooth
schema.description: Also find classic Bluetooth devices (speakers, car kits, some phones) that are in discoverable mode. Can make Bluetooth audio stutter while scanning. Toggle with B in the radar.

schema.label: Wi-Fi networks
schema.description: Show nearby Wi-Fi networks on the radar. Toggle with W in the radar.

schema.label: Only show devices within (metres)
schema.description: Hide devices estimated farther than this. 0 shows everything. Cycle all / 10 m / 3 m with F in the radar.

schema.label: Hide unidentified devices
schema.description: Hide devices that send neither a name nor anything recognisable. Toggle with U in the radar.

schema.label: Guard
schema.description: Warn when a tracker away from its owner (AirTag, SmartTag, Tile…) stays near you for 30+ minutes, or camera glasses (Ray-Ban/Oakley Meta…) are close. Scans 20 s every 2 min while the radar is off. Toggle with G in the radar.
